column1: # Original generic unit rules prompted by an external benchmark coverage audit.
# Values retain exact magnitude; no unit conversion or corpus-specific exact rules.
# Explicit degree mark disambiguates temperature from contextual building F.
# Per-forms and units the external English sample leaves unnormalized today.
# The lowercase spelling maps to the declared mL unit rather than a second id.
# Symbols that reached the synthesizer as written. A scale keeps winning over the
# bare degree because the longest declared suffix matches first.
